title: WOW: Add support for versions 2.0.0 and newer
description:
Partially fixes https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/11398 by adding support for versions at 2.0.0 and newer.

Primary sources are the [wiki](https://wowdev.wiki/Login_Packet) and [cMangos](https://github.com/cmangos/mangos-tbc/blob/master/src/realmd/AuthSocket.cpp#L125) sources. More specific links are in the commit messages.

With this merged the only changes I need to do for the issue are patching packets and survey result for 1.12, both of which should be on the way.
